wins: Maintained stable agent operations through the full episode without runtime exceptions, indicating environment resilience.
Recorded consistent reward of 60.0, demonstrating the agent was able to execute a baseline reconnaissance pipeline end-to-end.
fails: 0% success rate indicates failure to achieve any defined mission goals despite completing the episode.
High dependency on mentor interventions (10 calls) suggests strategy lacked autonomous decision-making in critical junctures.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent reliably completes scripted steps but does not reach mission goals; requires focused improvements on autonomous decision-making and follow-through after reconnaissance.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent stalls after initial reconnaissance and never executes offensive actions, leaving mission incomplete.
Agent requests mentor guidance before every major action, indicating failure to internalize next-step procedures.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 is detected open during initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Launch HTTP enumeration using nikto and curl fingerprinting

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration reveals SSH and telnet both open
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize SSH brute forcing with hydra and capture banners for credential reuse

skill_cards.if_condition: When privilege escalation candidate binaries are present
skill_cards.then_action: Run linpeas privileged checks and evaluate PATH misconfigurations

memory_ops.reason: Demonstrated consistent baseline reconnaissance steps with repeatable success.
SSH and telnet enumeration were attempted reliably, offering a foundation for credential harvesting.

next_experiments.title: Autonomous post-reconnaissance escalation
next_experiments.description: Trigger predefined privilege escalation procedures (linpeas + suid checks) immediately after successful reconnaissance scans without mentor prompts to reduce dependence.

next_experiments.title: Decision threshold tuning
next_experiments.description: Adjust confidence thresholds for agent transitions from reconnaissance to exploitation to prompt action when service evidence is strong.

next_experiments.title: Mentor guidance weaning
next_experiments.description: Gradually reduce mentor call availability to force the agent to execute learned skill cards and record decisions.
